source_shapes.unhung: Native sw_shawl tile: top loop and two long hanging/draped lattice strips with pale frayed lower ends. This is the portable hammock appearance, not a new clothing item or creature.
source_shapes.hanging: Native sw_hammock tile: sagging diagonal rope lattice between a lower-left and upper-right end; open lower weave, selected pale inner edge and bright end tips. No support trees or stand are included in the tile.

palette.rule: TileColor explicitly supplies y for tile primary; ColorString Y remains glyph metadata. Native hanging render changes tile only, not colors. Main rope mesh uses y; selected bright strands/fringes/end tips use Y. Cyan authoring strands are an extraction aid; final layers are neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed legacy FishingNetMote supplies readable crossed-rope lattice and open mesh spacing only. It is retained legacy mod art, not claimed as an active current hammock asset. Its circular net outline, endpoint dots, fishing/vehicle behavior and source colors are not copied.

reference_limits: Focused installed filename search found no direct hammock asset. Melee Animation coiled rope was viewed but not selected; the actual net is the closer lattice-material reference. Qud source tiles control both state silhouettes.
construction: Two editable rope-mesh silhouettes use actual open weave because the description specifies a lattice. The portable state keeps the source loop/two draped strips and frayed ends; the hanging state keeps source diagonal sag, end locations and frayed center. Mesh spacing, individual braids/knots and exact fray fibers are authored interpretation. No opaque blanket, clothing mannequin, baked trees, rigid stand or swinging animation.

native_state.rule: Hangable.CheckHanging uses actual native support availability; Render replaces E.Tile with HangingTile only while Hanging. Entered/LeftCell and zone lifecycle remain native. Keep2-weight organic takeable non-solid Bed/Hangable behavior, Hitpoints5and native support rules. No art-owned hanging state or new support objects.
native_state.render_color_evidence: Render.getTileColor returns the explicit TileColor when present; both native states retain the declared y/Y tile roles.

frame.rule: One complete source-cell mapping for each native state and all role masks. Do not separately center mesh, fringes, end tips or state-specific visible alpha bounds.
